name: torchtune
summary: PyTorch-native BSD-3-Clause library for authoring, fine-tuning and evaluating LLMs with native PyTorch training primitives.
description: The official README states that torchtune is no longer actively maintained and that development wound down in 2025, linking to "The future of torchtune" (https://github.com/meta-pytorch/torchtune/issues/2883). Chosen schema-valid status deprecated (the schema has active/beta/deprecated/unknown, not archived or unmaintained). The GitHub repository meta-pytorch/torchtune is not archived (GitHub API archived=false, disabled=false as of 2026-11-11). PyPI torchtune 0.6.1 remains the current listed release, is not yanked, is BSD-3-Clause, and is still installable. Established PyTorch project (not a 2026 launch). Docs at https://pytorch.org/torchtune/main/ currently redirect to https://meta-pytorch.org/torchtune/main/. GPU and model-weight requirements are separate.

agent_access.notes: Local Python package: pip install torchtune. Follow the official docs for model and hardware setup.
